title: How to access information held by Service NSW
summary: This page provides information on how to make requests for accessing government information under the Government Information (Public Access) Act 2009 (NSW).
who_can_apply: Any citizen or entity can apply for information held by Service NSW or other government bodies.
what_you_need: A written request stating you are requesting information under the Government Information (Public Access) Act 2009 (NSW).
Your name, an email address, or return postal address.
Specific details about the information you are requesting.
processing_time:
We will acknowledge receipt of a valid access application within 5 working days, and will process your application within 20 working days (subject to any extension allowed for under the Act).

If any extension of time is required to process your application, we will let you know in writing.
contact:
If your enquiry relates to Transport for NSW or the NSW Police Force you can contact them directly.

faqs.q: How long will it take to process an access application?
faqs.a: Service NSW will acknowledge receipt of a valid access application within 5 working days, and will process your application within 20 working days (subject to any extension allowed for under the Act).

faqs.q: How can I make a formal access application?
faqs.a: You can apply by emailing gipa@customerservice.nsw.gov.au, visiting a Service NSW Centre, or posting your application with a money order or cheque to the Service NSW GIPA Team.

faqs.q: What information must I include when applying?
faqs.a: Your application must be in writing and clearly state that you are requesting information under the Government Information (Public Access) Act 2009 (NSW). You must also include the $30 application fee, your name, an email address or return postal address, and specific information to identify the information you are asking for.
